# Migration Guide: Docker-LXC Module Pattern

This guide documents the standard pattern for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers using pure OpenTofu (no manual provisioners).

## Overview

The **docker-lxc module** is the gold standard for all Docker app deployments. It provides:

- LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
- File synchronization via rsync (file-sync module)
- Docker Compose stack deployment
- Automatic Proxmox notes generation
- Consistent, declarative infrastructure

## Module Architecture

```text
docker-lxc module
├── lxc-base module          # Container creation & configuration
├── file-sync module         # Rsync-based file transfer
└── remote-docker-compose    # Docker Compose deployment
```

## Standard Deployment Pattern

### Directory Structure

```text
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf              # Module invocation
├── notes.md             # Custom documentation (optional)
├── ip-registry.tf       # IP allocation (symlinked from tofu/)
├── shared.tf            # Common variables (symlinked from tofu/)
├── versions.tf          # Provider config (symlinked from tofu/)
└── deploy/
    ├── docker-compose.yml
    ├── .env.tpl         # Template for secrets (if needed)
    ├── .env.example     # Documentation
    └── config/          # App configuration files
```

### Basic main.tf Template

```hcl
# =============================================================================
# MyApp LXC - Brief Description
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: XXX
# IP: 192.168.1.XXX

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (optional - customize resources)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for MyApp LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = XXX
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MyApp Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.myapp}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory

  # Privileged container if binding to ports < 1024
  unprivileged = false  # or true for most apps

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "MyApp"
  service_description = "Brief description of what this app does"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://myapp.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main web interface" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["myapp", "category"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.myapp.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.myapp.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.myapp.ssh_command
}
```

## Secret Management Pattern

For apps requiring secrets (API keys, passwords, etc.), use the **local_sensitive_file + filesync_file** pattern:

### 1. Create .env.tpl Template

```bash
# deploy/.env.tpl
API_KEY=${api_key}
DATABASE_PASSWORD=${db_password}
```

### 2. Add Secret Resources to main.tf

```hcl
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Secret Management
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "myapp_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    api_key     = local.op.myapp_api_key
    db_password = local.op.myapp_db_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/myapp.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "myapp_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.myapp_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.ip_registry.apps.myapp

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.myapp]
}
```

### 3. Add .terraform/ to .gitignore

```bash
echo ".terraform/" >> .gitignore
```

### 4. Create .env.example

```bash
# deploy/.env.example
# Example environment variables for MyApp
# The actual .env file is generated by OpenTofu from .env.tpl
# using secrets from 1Password

API_KEY=your_api_key_here
DATABASE_PASSWORD=your_password_here
```

### 5. Add Secrets to 1Password

1. Create item in `homelab` vault
2. Add to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

```hcl
data "onepassword_item" "myapp" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "myapp"
}

# In locals.op map:
op = {
  # ... existing secrets ...
  myapp_api_key     = data.onepassword_item.myapp.password
  myapp_db_password = lookup(local._myapp_fields, "db_password", "")
}
```

## Migration Checklist

### Pre-Migration

- [ ] Backup any important data from existing deployment
- [ ] Document current configuration
- [ ] Get next available IP: `task ip:next`
- [ ] Add IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`

### Migration Steps

1. **Create app directory structure**

   ```bash
   mkdir -p tofu/apps/myapp/deploy
   cd tofu/apps/myapp
   ln -s ../../shared.tf .
   ln -s ../../versions.tf .
   ln -s ../../ip-registry.tf .
   ```

2. **Copy deployment files**

   ```bash
   # Copy docker-compose.yml and configs to deploy/
   cp /path/to/docker-compose.yml deploy/
   cp -r /path/to/configs deploy/
   ```

3. **Create main.tf using template above**

4. **Add secrets if needed** (follow Secret Management Pattern)

5. **Create notes.md** (optional)

   ```markdown
   ## Quick Commands

   **View logs:**
   ```

   docker compose logs -f

   ```text

   **Restart service:**
   docker compose restart
   ```

6. **Initialize and plan**

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=myapp
   task tofu:plan APP=myapp
   ```

7. **Apply**

   ```bash
   task tofu:apply APP=myapp
   ```

8. **Verify**

   ```bash
   task tofu:ssh APP=myapp
   docker ps
   curl https://myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Post-Migration

- [ ] Test application functionality
- [ ] Update monitoring/backups if needed
- [ ] Document any app-specific quirks in notes.md
- [ ] Remove old deployment (if replacing existing)

## Benefits Over Manual Deployments

### Before (Manual/Mixed Approach)

- Mix of Terraform resources and null_resource provisioners
- Manual SSH commands in remote-exec blocks
- Difficult to track state and detect drift
- Inconsistent patterns across apps
- Hard to maintain and debug

### After (docker-lxc Module)

- Pure declarative OpenTofu
- Consistent pattern across all apps
- Proper state management and drift detection
- Automatic documentation via Proxmox notes
- Easy to maintain and replicate
- Native Terraform resource lifecycle

## Migrated Applications

- ✅ **Traefik** (ID: 200) - First migration, includes secret management
- ✅ **n8n** (ID: 213) - Test case for provider v0.3.0
- ✅ **Dashboards** (ID: 234) - Homepage + Dashy
- ✅ **Portainer** (ID: 157) - Container management
- ✅ **Monitoring** (ID: 500) - Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting

## Common Patterns

### Privileged vs Unprivileged Containers

```hcl
# Use privileged for:
# - Binding to ports < 1024 (80, 443)
# - Special kernel features
unprivileged = false

# Use unprivileged for:
# - Most applications
# - Better security isolation
unprivileged = true  # default
```

### Multiple Services in One Container

```hcl
services = [
  { name = "Web UI", port = 3000, info = "Main interface" },
  { name = "API", port = 8080, info = "REST API" },
  { name = "Metrics", port = 9090, info = "Prometheus metrics" }
]
```

### Public Routes (Cloudflare Tunnel)

```hcl
service_urls = {
  internal = "https://myapp.${var.domain_internal}"
  public   = "https://myapp.rambtech.dev"  # via Cloudflare tunnel
}
```

## Troubleshooting

### Container won't start after creation

```bash
# Check container status
ssh root@homelab pct status <id>

# View container logs
ssh root@homelab pct enter <id>
journalctl -xe
```

### Docker not running

```bash
# SSH to container
task tofu:ssh APP=myapp

# Check Docker status
systemctl status docker

# Check if using correct template
# Should be: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst
pct config <id> | grep ostemplate
```

### File sync issues

```bash
# Files not syncing:
# 1. Check file-sync module logs in terraform output
# 2. Verify SSH access: ssh root@<ip>
# 3. Check file permissions in deploy/ directory
# 4. Run manual rsync to debug:
rsync -avz --checksum deploy/ root@<ip>:/config/
```

### Secrets not working

```bash

op item get <item-name> --vault homelab

# Check local sensitive file created
ls -la .terraform/*.env

# Verify file synced to container
task tofu:ssh APP=myapp
cat /config/.env
```

## Tips and Best Practices

1. **Always use docker-lxc module** - Don't create custom patterns
2. **Keep notes.md up to date** - Future you will thank you
3. **Use semantic versioning for images** - Avoid `:latest`
4. **Test in plan first** - Always review before apply
5. **Document secrets** - Add clear .env.example files
6. **Use consistent naming** - Follow existing app naming conventions
7. **Commit state files** - They're encrypted and safe to commit

## Reference Examples

See these apps for complete examples:

- **Simple app**: `tofu/apps/portainer/` - Minimal configuration
- **With secrets**: `tofu/apps/traefik/` - Secret management pattern
- **Complex multi-service**: `tofu/apps/monitoring/` - Multiple containers, services

## Next Steps

To migrate an app:

1. Read this guide thoroughly
2. Review reference examples
3. Follow migration checklist
4. Test in plan mode first
5. Ask for review if unsure

---

     2→# Docker LXC Module
     3→# =============================================================================
     4→# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
     5→# Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file into one module.
     6→#
     7→# This is the gold standard pattern for all Docker app deployments.
     8→#
     9→# Usage:
    10→#   module "my_app" {
    11→#     source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
    12→#
    13→#     # Identity
    14→#     name         = "my-app"
    15→#     container_id = 100
    16→#
    17→#     # Network
    18→#     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
    19→#     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
    20→#
    21→#     # Resources
    22→#     cores  = 2
    23→#     memory = 2048
    24→#
    25→#     # Deployment
    26→#     deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
    27→#
    28→#     # SSH
    29→#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
    30→#   }
    31→# =============================================================================
    32→
    33→terraform {
    34→  required_providers {
    35→    proxmox = {
    36→      source = "bpg/proxmox"
    37→    }
    38→    null = {
    39→      source = "hashicorp/null"
    40→    }
    41→    remotedockercompose = {
    42→      source = "darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file"
    43→    }
    44→  }
    45→}
    46→
    47→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    48→# Build Description for Proxmox UI
    49→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    50→
    51→locals {
    52→  # Service name defaults to container name
    53→  service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    54→
    55→  # Build container description (supports markdown)
    56→  # Note: We can't use the IP from module.lxc.ip_address here because of circular dependency
    57→  # So we extract it from the input var.ip_address instead
    58→  #
    59→  # Timestamp is omitted because both timestamp() and plantimestamp() create drift:
    60→  # - timestamp() changes on every plan/apply
    61→  # - plantimestamp() changes on every plan (even if not applied)
    62→  # To track last update time, Proxmox automatically tracks modification time
    63→  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    64→    service_name = local.service_name
    65→    description  = var.service_description
    66→    urls         = var.service_urls
    67→    services     = var.services
    68→    ssh_host     = var.ip_address != "" ? split("/", var.ip_address)[0] : ""
    69→    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    70→    managed_by   = true
    71→  }) : ""
    72→}
    73→
    74→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    75→# LXC Container
    76→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    77→
    78→module "lxc" {
    79→  source = "../lxc-base"
    80→
    81→  name         = var.name
    82→  container_id = var.container_id
    83→  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node
    84→
    85→  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key
    86→
    87→  cores  = var.cores
    88→  memory = var.memory
    89→  swap   = var.swap
    90→
    91→  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
    92→  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
    93→
    94→  # Network
    95→  ip_address = var.ip_address
    96→  gateway    = var.gateway
    97→
    98→  # Docker-ready template
    99→  template = var.template
   100→
   101→  # Container security
   102→  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
   103→  enable_nesting = true
   104→  enable_keyctl  = true
   105→
   106→  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
   107→  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
   108→  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
   109→
   110→  # Description for Proxmox UI
   111→  description = local.description
   112→
   113→  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
   114→}
   115→
   116→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   117→# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
   118→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   119→# Only created if deploy_dir is provided
   120→
   121→module "file_sync" {
   122→  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
   123→  source = "../file-sync"
   124→
   125→  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
   126→  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
   127→  target_path          = var.target_path
   128→  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
   129→
   130→  # Ensure Docker is running
   131→  post_sync_commands = concat([
   132→    "systemctl start docker || true",
   133→    "systemctl enable docker || true"
   134→  ], var.post_sync_commands)
   135→
   136→  # Set ownership if specified
   137→  owner = var.config_owner
   138→  group = var.config_group
   139→
   140→  # File permissions
   141→  file_permissions = var.file_permissions
   142→
   143→  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files
   144→
   145→  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
   146→}
   147→
   148→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   149→# Docker Compose Stack
   150→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   151→
   152→resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
   153→  provider = remotedockercompose
   154→
   155→  # depends_on must be static, so we always include both
   156→  depends_on = [
   157→    module.lxc,
   158→    module.file_sync
   159→  ]
   160→
   161→  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
   162→  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
   163→  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")
   164→
   165→  up       = var.docker_compose_up
   166→  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
   167→}

   171→# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Build container description (supports markdown)
  # Note: We can't use the IP from module.lxc.ip_address here because of circular dependency
  # So we extract it from the input var.ip_address instead
  #
  # Timestamp is omitted because both timestamp() and plantimestamp() create drift:
  # - timestamp() changes on every plan/apply
  # - plantimestamp() changes on every plan (even if not applied)
  # To track last update time, Proxmox automatically tracks modification time
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = local.service_name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = var.ip_address != "" ? split("/", var.ip_address)[0] : ""
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Network
  ip_address = var.ip_address
  gateway    = var.gateway

  # Docker-ready template
  template = var.template

  # Container security
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Description for Proxmox UI
  description = local.description

  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only created if deploy_dir is provided

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running
  post_sync_commands = concat([
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ], var.post_sync_commands)

  # Set ownership if specified
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions

  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  provider = remotedockercompose

  # depends_on must be static, so we always include both
  depends_on = [
    module.lxc,
    module.file_sync
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notes are now managed directly via the LXC description parameter above
# The proxmox-notes module is deprecated and no longer needed

1→# Provider SSH Known_Hosts Issues
     2→
     3→## Problem Summary
     4→
     5→Both `darshan-rambhia/filesync` and `darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file` providers fail with SSH handshake errors related to known_hosts validation, even when:
     6→
     7→- Manual SSH connections work perfectly
     8→- Known_hosts file is clean with only valid entries
     9→- Host keys are freshly added
    10→
    11→## Error Messages
    12→
    13→### filesync Provider
    14→
    15→```hcl
    16→Error: Failed to create SSH connection
    17→
    18→  with module.n8n_route.filesync_file.traefik_route,
    19→  on ../../modules/traefik-route/main.tf line 117, in resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route":
    20→ 117: resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route" {
    21→
    22→failed to connect to 192.168.1.235:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
    23→```
    24→
    25→### remote-docker-compose-file Provider
    26→
    27→```hcl
    28→Error: Failed to create SSH connection
    29→
    30→  with module.n8n.remote-docker-compose-file_stack.app,
    31→  on ../../modules/docker-lxc/main.tf line 122, in resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app":
    32→ 122: resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {
    33→
    34→failed to create gosftp client: failed to connect to 192.168.1.213:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
    35→```
    36→
    37→## Reproduction Steps
    38→
    39→1. Deploy LXC container with static IP
    40→2. SSH manually works: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.213` ✅
    41→3. Clean known_hosts: `ssh-keygen -R 192.168.1.213`
    42→4. Add fresh host key: `ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new root@192.168.1.213 "hostname"`
    43→5. Verify known_hosts has single valid entry
    44→6. Run `tofu apply` with filesync_file or remote-docker-compose-file_stack resource
    45→7. **FAILS** with "key mismatch" or "key is unknown" ❌
    46→
    47→## Environment
    48→
    49→- **OS**: macOS (Darwin 24.6.0)
    50→- **Providers**:
    51→  - `darshan-rambhia/filesync` v0.2.0
    52→  - `darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file` v0.2.0
    53→- **OpenTofu**: Latest version
    54→- **SSH**: OpenSSH (manual connections work)
    55→- **Known_hosts format**: Standard OpenSSH format (not hashed)
    56→
    57→## Known_Hosts File State (Working)
    58→
    59→```bash
    60→# Clean file with only 2 entries
    61→$ cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts
    62→192.168.1.213 ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAuig0G/vrj5imZLZqUsvq8P0+BVNV+Ou372e7QhjRz6
    63→192.168.1.235 ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC+I2zNQP3gu6Vvh1jZiOX34lkXeMN+VzbA1FUl17WFg
    64→
    65→# Manual SSH works perfectly
    66→$ ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.213 "hostname"
    67→n8n  # ✅ Success!
    68→
    69→$ ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.235 "hostname"
    70→traefik  # ✅ Success!
    71→```
    72→
    73→## Resource Configuration
    74→
    75→### filesync_file Resource
    76→
    77→```hcl
    78→resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route" {
    79→  source      = local_file.route_config.filename
    80→  destination = "/config/dynamic/n8n.yml"
    81→  host        = "192.168.1.235"
    82→
    83→  # SSH configuration
    84→  ssh_key_path = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"
    85→
    86→  # File permissions
    87→  owner = "root"
    88→  group = "root"
    89→  mode  = "0644"
    90→}
    91→```
    92→
    93→### remote-docker-compose-file_stack Resource
    94→
    95→```hcl
    96→resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {
    97→  provider = remotedockercompose
    98→
    99→  host        = "192.168.1.213"
   100→  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
   101→  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")
   102→
   103→  up       = true
   104→  validate = true
   105→}
   106→```
   107→
   108→## Root Cause Hypothesis
   109→
   110→Both providers likely use Go's `golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/knownhosts` package which has **stricter validation** than OpenSSH:
   111→
   112→1. **Key Format Sensitivity**: May not handle certain known_hosts formats properly
   113→2. **Cache Issues**: Might cache old keys internally
   114→3. **File Locking**: Could have race conditions with known_hosts updates
   115→4. **Hash Handling**: May fail with hashed hostnames even when not using them
   116→5. **Multiple Entries**: Doesn't gracefully handle duplicate/stale entries
   117→
   118→## ⚠️ Critical Finding: insecure_ignore_host_key Incomplete
   119→
   120→Both providers **already have** `insecure_ignore_host_key` parameter, **BUT IT'S BROKEN**:
   121→
   122→- ✅ Works for CREATE operations
   123→- ❌ **FAILS for READ/REFRESH operations**
   124→
   125→**Evidence**:
   126→
   127→```hcl
   128→resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {
   129→  # ... config ...
   130→  insecure_ignore_host_key = true  # Added this parameter
   131→}
   132→```
   133→
   134→**Still fails during `tofu apply`/`tofu refresh`**:
   135→
   136→```
   137→Error: Failed to create SSH connection
   138→failed to create gosftp client: failed to connect to 192.168.1.213:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
   139→```
   140→
   141→**Root Issue**: The parameter is only applied during resource creation, not during state refresh/read operations. The providers need to use the same SSH client configuration for ALL operations.
   142→
   143→## Temporary Workarounds
   144→
   145→### Option 1: Manual File Deployment + Import
   146→
   147→```bash
   148→# Deploy file manually
   149→scp config.yml root@192.168.1.235:/config/dynamic/
   150→
   151→# Import into Terraform state
   152→tofu import 'module.app_route.filesync_file.traefik_route' '192.168.1.235:/config/dynamic/config.yml'
   153→```
   154→
   155→### Option 2: Use null_resource with rsync
   156→
   157→```hcl
   158→resource "null_resource" "deploy_file" {
   159→  provisioner "local-exec" {
   160→    command = "rsync -avz ${local_file.config.filename} root@${var.host}:${var.destination}"
   161→  }
   162→}
   163→```
   164→
   165→### Option 3: Disable Host Key Checking (NOT RECOMMENDED)
   166→
   167→Add provider configuration to skip verification (if providers support it).
   168→
   169→## Recommended Fix
   170→
   171→### For Both Providers
   172→
   173→1. **Add SSH Options Parameter**
   174→
   175→   ```hcl
   176→   resource "filesync_file" "example" {
   177→     # ...
   178→     ssh_options = {
   179→       strict_host_key_checking = "accept-new"  # or "no" for testing
   180→       user_known_hosts_file    = "/dev/null"   # optional for CI/CD
   181→     }
   182→   }
   183→   ```
   184→
   185→2. **Fix insecure_ignore_host_key to Work in ALL Operations**
   186→
   187→   **Current Bug** - Parameter only applies to CREATE:
   188→   ```go
   189→   // In resource Create method (WORKS)
   190→   func (r *Resource) Create(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   191→       sshConfig := getSSHConfig(r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey)  // ✅ Uses parameter
   192→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   193→   }
   194→
   195→   // In resource Read method (BROKEN)
   196→   func (r *Resource) Read(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   197→       sshConfig := getSSHConfig(false)  // ❌ Hardcoded to false!
   198→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   199→   }
   200→   ```
   201→
   202→   **The Fix** - Use parameter in ALL methods:
   203→   ```go
   204→   // Store the parameter in the resource struct
   205→   type Resource struct {
   206→       InsecureIgnoreHostKey bool
   207→   }
   208→
   209→   // Use it consistently in ALL operations
   210→   func (r *Resource) Create(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   211→       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Always uses r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey
   212→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   213→   }
   214→
   215→   func (r *Resource) Read(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   216→       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
   217→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   218→   }
   219→
   220→   func (r *Resource) Update(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   221→       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
   222→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   223→   }
   224→
   225→   func (r *Resource) Delete(ctx context.Context, ...) {
   226→       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
   227→       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   228→   }
   229→
   230→   // Helper to build SSH config based on parameter
   231→   func (r *Resource) getSSHConfig() *ssh.ClientConfig {
   232→       var hostKeyCallback ssh.HostKeyCallback
   233→
   234→       if r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey {
   235→           hostKeyCallback = ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey()
   236→       } else {
   237→           // Use known_hosts validation
   238→           hostKeyCallback = ssh.FixedHostKey(...)
   239→       }
   240→
   241→       return &ssh.ClientConfig{
   242→           User:            r.SSHUser,
   243→           Auth:            []ssh.AuthMethod{...},
   244→           HostKeyCallback: hostKeyCallback,
   245→       }
   246→   }
   247→   ```
   248→
   249→3. **Improve Known_Hosts Handling**
   250→   - Use `ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey()` callback option when `insecure_ignore_host_key = true`
   251→   - Better error messages showing:
   252→     - Expected key fingerprint
   253→     - Actual key fingerprint
   254→     - Known_hosts file location
   255→   - Automatically remove stale entries on mismatch
   256→
   257→4. **Add Debug Logging**
   258→
   259→   ```bash
   260→   TF_LOG=DEBUG tofu apply
   261→   # Should show:
   262→   # - Which known_hosts file is being read
   263→   # - Key being validated
   264→   # - Why validation failed
   265→   ```
   266→
   267→4. **Support SSH Config Files**
   268→   Respect `~/.ssh/config` settings like:
   269→
   270→   ```hclI think you should add that to the document
   271→   Host 192.168.1.*
   272→       StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
   273→       UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts
   274→   ```
   275→
   276→## Test Cases to Add
   277→
   278→1. **Fresh Host Key** - First connection to new host
   279→2. **Updated Host Key** - Host key changed (e.g., after reinstall)
   280→3. **Multiple Entries** - Same IP with different keys
   281→4. **Hashed Known_Hosts** - `HashKnownHosts yes` in ssh_config
   282→5. **Empty Known_Hosts** - No existing entries
   283→6. **Concurrent Updates** - Multiple resources updating known_hosts simultaneously
   284→
   285→## Success Criteria
   286→
   287→- ✅ Works with clean known_hosts
   288→- ✅ Works with existing valid entry
   289→- ✅ Provides clear error on key mismatch with fingerprints
   290→- ✅ Option to auto-accept new/changed keys
   291→- ✅ Respects SSH config files
   292→- ✅ Thread-safe known_hosts updates
   293→
   294→## Impact
   295→
   296→- **Current**: Blocks adoption of self-service modules
   297→- **After Fix**: Enables:
   298→  - traefik-route module for auto-route registration
   299→  - docker-lxc module for seamless deployments
   300→  - Any other SSH-based automation
   301→
   302→## Related Files
   303→
   304→- `tofu/modules/traefik-route/main.tf` - Uses filesync_file
   305→- `tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf` - Uses remote-docker-compose-file_stack
   306→- `tofu/modules/file-sync/main.tf` - Uses filesync_directory/filesync_file
   307→
   308→## Timeline
   309→
   310→- **Discovered**: 2025-12-10
   311→- **Workaround**: Manual deployment + import
   312→- **Fix Priority**: High (blocks module adoption)
   313→- **Estimated Fix**: 1-2 hours per provider
   314→
   315→## Additional Notes
   316→
   317→The `filesync` provider **can successfully import** existing files (read operation works), but **fails to create/update** them. This suggests:
   318→
   319→- The SSH connection for read operations might use different code path
   320→- Import might skip known_hosts validation
   321→- Create/update operations have stricter checks
   322→
   323→This asymmetry should be investigated - ideally both operations should use the same SSH client configuration.

# Provider SSH Known_Hosts Issues

## Problem Summary

Both `darshan-rambhia/filesync` and `darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file` providers fail with SSH handshake errors related to known_hosts validation, even when:

- Manual SSH connections work perfectly
- Known_hosts file is clean with only valid entries
- Host keys are freshly added

## Error Messages

### filesync Provider

```hcl
Error: Failed to create SSH connection

  with module.n8n_route.filesync_file.traefik_route,
  on ../../modules/traefik-route/main.tf line 117, in resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route":
 117: resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route" {

failed to connect to 192.168.1.235:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
```

### remote-docker-compose-file Provider

```hcl
Error: Failed to create SSH connection

  with module.n8n.remote-docker-compose-file_stack.app,
  on ../../modules/docker-lxc/main.tf line 122, in resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app":
 122: resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {

failed to create gosftp client: failed to connect to 192.168.1.213:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
```

## Reproduction Steps

1. Deploy LXC container with static IP
2. SSH manually works: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.213` ✅
3. Clean known_hosts: `ssh-keygen -R 192.168.1.213`
4. Add fresh host key: `ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new root@192.168.1.213 "hostname"`
5. Verify known_hosts has single valid entry
6. Run `tofu apply` with filesync_file or remote-docker-compose-file_stack resource
7. **FAILS** with "key mismatch" or "key is unknown" ❌

## Environment

- **OS**: macOS (Darwin 24.6.0)
- **Providers**:
  - `darshan-rambhia/filesync` v0.2.0
  - `darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file` v0.2.0
- **OpenTofu**: Latest version
- **SSH**: OpenSSH (manual connections work)
- **Known_hosts format**: Standard OpenSSH format (not hashed)

## Known_Hosts File State (Working)

```bash
# Clean file with only 2 entries
$ cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts
192.168.1.213 ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAuig0G/vrj5imZLZqUsvq8P0+BVNV+Ou372e7QhjRz6
192.168.1.235 ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC+I2zNQP3gu6Vvh1jZiOX34lkXeMN+VzbA1FUl17WFg

# Manual SSH works perfectly
$ ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.213 "hostname"
n8n  # ✅ Success!

$ ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519 root@192.168.1.235 "hostname"
traefik  # ✅ Success!
```

## Resource Configuration

### filesync_file Resource

```hcl
resource "filesync_file" "traefik_route" {
  source      = local_file.route_config.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/n8n.yml"
  host        = "192.168.1.235"

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_key_path = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"

  # File permissions
  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}
```

### remote-docker-compose-file_stack Resource

```hcl
resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {
  provider = remotedockercompose

  host        = "192.168.1.213"
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}
```

## Root Cause Hypothesis

Both providers likely use Go's `golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/knownhosts` package which has **stricter validation** than OpenSSH:

1. **Key Format Sensitivity**: May not handle certain known_hosts formats properly
2. **Cache Issues**: Might cache old keys internally
3. **File Locking**: Could have race conditions with known_hosts updates
4. **Hash Handling**: May fail with hashed hostnames even when not using them
5. **Multiple Entries**: Doesn't gracefully handle duplicate/stale entries

## ⚠️ Critical Finding: insecure_ignore_host_key Incomplete

Both providers **already have** `insecure_ignore_host_key` parameter, **BUT IT'S BROKEN**:

- ✅ Works for CREATE operations
- ❌ **FAILS for READ/REFRESH operations**

**Evidence**:

```hcl
resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "app" {
  # ... config ...
  insecure_ignore_host_key = true  # Added this parameter
}
```

**Still fails during `tofu apply`/`tofu refresh`**:

```
Error: Failed to create SSH connection
failed to create gosftp client: failed to connect to 192.168.1.213:22: ssh: handshake failed: knownhosts: key mismatch
```

**Root Issue**: The parameter is only applied during resource creation, not during state refresh/read operations. The providers need to use the same SSH client configuration for ALL operations.

## Temporary Workarounds

### Option 1: Manual File Deployment + Import

```bash
# Deploy file manually
scp config.yml root@192.168.1.235:/config/dynamic/

# Import into Terraform state
tofu import 'module.app_route.filesync_file.traefik_route' '192.168.1.235:/config/dynamic/config.yml'
```

### Option 2: Use null_resource with rsync

```hcl
resource "null_resource" "deploy_file" {
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = "rsync -avz ${local_file.config.filename} root@${var.host}:${var.destination}"
  }
}
```

### Option 3: Disable Host Key Checking (NOT RECOMMENDED)

Add provider configuration to skip verification (if providers support it).

## Recommended Fix

### For Both Providers

1. **Add SSH Options Parameter**

   ```hcl
   resource "filesync_file" "example" {
     # ...
     ssh_options = {
       strict_host_key_checking = "accept-new"  # or "no" for testing
       user_known_hosts_file    = "/dev/null"   # optional for CI/CD
     }
   }
   ```

2. **Fix insecure_ignore_host_key to Work in ALL Operations**

   **Current Bug** - Parameter only applies to CREATE:
   ```go
   // In resource Create method (WORKS)
   func (r *Resource) Create(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := getSSHConfig(r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey)  // ✅ Uses parameter
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }

   // In resource Read method (BROKEN)
   func (r *Resource) Read(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := getSSHConfig(false)  // ❌ Hardcoded to false!
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }
   ```

   **The Fix** - Use parameter in ALL methods:
   ```go
   // Store the parameter in the resource struct
   type Resource struct {
       InsecureIgnoreHostKey bool
   }

   // Use it consistently in ALL operations
   func (r *Resource) Create(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Always uses r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }

   func (r *Resource) Read(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }

   func (r *Resource) Update(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }

   func (r *Resource) Delete(ctx context.Context, ...) {
       sshConfig := r.getSSHConfig()  // ✅ Same config as Create
       client, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", addr, sshConfig)
   }

   // Helper to build SSH config based on parameter
   func (r *Resource) getSSHConfig() *ssh.ClientConfig {
       var hostKeyCallback ssh.HostKeyCallback

       if r.InsecureIgnoreHostKey {
           hostKeyCallback = ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey()
       } else {
           // Use known_hosts validation
           hostKeyCallback = ssh.FixedHostKey(...)
       }

       return &ssh.ClientConfig{
           User:            r.SSHUser,
           Auth:            []ssh.AuthMethod{...},
           HostKeyCallback: hostKeyCallback,
       }
   }
   ```

3. **Improve Known_Hosts Handling**
   - Use `ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey()` callback option when `insecure_ignore_host_key = true`
   - Better error messages showing:
     - Expected key fingerprint
     - Actual key fingerprint
     - Known_hosts file location
   - Automatically remove stale entries on mismatch

4. **Add Debug Logging**

   ```bash
   TF_LOG=DEBUG tofu apply
   # Should show:
   # - Which known_hosts file is being read
   # - Key being validated
   # - Why validation failed
   ```

4. **Support SSH Config Files**
   Respect `~/.ssh/config` settings like:

   ```hclI think you should add that to the document
   Host 192.168.1.*
       StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
       UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts
   ```

## Test Cases to Add

1. **Fresh Host Key** - First connection to new host
2. **Updated Host Key** - Host key changed (e.g., after reinstall)
3. **Multiple Entries** - Same IP with different keys
4. **Hashed Known_Hosts** - `HashKnownHosts yes` in ssh_config
5. **Empty Known_Hosts** - No existing entries
6. **Concurrent Updates** - Multiple resources updating known_hosts simultaneously

## Success Criteria

- ✅ Works with clean known_hosts
- ✅ Works with existing valid entry
- ✅ Provides clear error on key mismatch with fingerprints
- ✅ Option to auto-accept new/changed keys
- ✅ Respects SSH config files
- ✅ Thread-safe known_hosts updates

## Impact

- **Current**: Blocks adoption of self-service modules
- **After Fix**: Enables:
  - traefik-route module for auto-route registration
  - docker-lxc module for seamless deployments
  - Any other SSH-based automation

## Related Files

- `tofu/modules/traefik-route/main.tf` - Uses filesync_file
- `tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf` - Uses remote-docker-compose-file_stack
- `tofu/modules/file-sync/main.tf` - Uses filesync_directory/filesync_file

## Timeline

- **Discovered**: 2025-12-10
- **Workaround**: Manual deployment + import
- **Fix Priority**: High (blocks module adoption)
- **Estimated Fix**: 1-2 hours per provider

## Additional Notes

The `filesync` provider **can successfully import** existing files (read operation works), but **fails to create/update** them. This suggests:

- The SSH connection for read operations might use different code path
- Import might skip known_hosts validation
- Create/update operations have stricter checks

This asymmetry should be investigated - ideally both operations should use the same SSH client configuration.

# Include shared variables
# Note: terraform.tfvars is symlinked from parent directory

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for dashboards LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 32
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024  # Match existing container
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # Existing container is privileged
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  tags = ["opentofu", "dashboards", "homepage", "dashy"]

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container apparmor configuration
  proxmox_ssh_host = var.proxmox_ssh_host
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Dashboards"
  description  = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications"

  urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4000, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.docker_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }
}

**Secrets:** `/config/secrets/` (generated from 1Password)

task authelia:secrets

```

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f authelia
```

**Check auth status:**
```
curl -I http://localhost:9091/api/health
```

## ForwardAuth Middleware

Add `"authelia"` to any service's middleware list to protect it:
```hcl
middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
```
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs

  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

  value = {

  }
}

# Immich LXC - Photo & Video Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 304 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Note: This app imports an existing LXC container rather than creating new.
# Immich runs as Docker containers with GPU acceleration for ML features.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Immich LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 6

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 24
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # Existing container is privileged for GPU access
}

variable "enable_gpu" {
  description = "Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # GPU added manually via SSH (API token can't manage device passthrough)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # GPU passthrough - managed outside of Terraform due to API limitations
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  tags = ["opentofu", "photos", "immich", "media"]

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container apparmor configuration
  proxmox_ssh_host = var.proxmox_ssh_host
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Immich"
  description  = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.docker_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** `/var/lib/docker/volumes/immich_pgdata`

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M is passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart all services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Backup

Database backups should be configured via Immich admin panel.
Photos are stored on ZFS pool with automatic snapshots.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.docker_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:2283"
  }
}

     4→# Generates and syncs Traefik dynamic configuration for an app.
     5→# Each app can self-register its routes without modifying Traefik configs.

     7→# Features:

    10→# - Supports internal (websecure) and public (web) routes
    11→# - Health checks, middlewares, custom options
    12→#
    13→# Usage:
    14→#   module "n8n_route" {
    15→#     source = "../../modules/traefik-route"
    16→#
    17→#     app_name    = "n8n"
    18→#     backend_url = "http://192.168.1.213:5678"
    19→#
    20→#     internal_domain = "n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev"
    21→#     public_domain   = ""  # Optional

    24→#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
    25→#   }

    28→terraform {
    29→  required_providers {
    30→    local = {
    31→      source = "hashicorp/local"
    32→    }
    33→    filesync = {
    34→      source = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"

#!/bin/bash
# Pre-migration backup script for docker-lxc module migration
# Backs up all container data and configurations before migration

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/homelab-migration-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
SSH_KEY="$HOME/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"

# Container mapping: name:id:ip
declare -a CONTAINERS=(
    "authelia:202:192.168.1.225"
    "immich-importer:203:192.168.1.223"
    "dashboards:201:192.168.1.234"
    "monitoring:500:192.168.1.229"
    "portainer:100:192.168.1.157"
    "openwebui:501:192.168.1.221"
    "jellyfin:401:192.168.1.226"
    "media-management:402:192.168.1.227"
    "immich:304:192.168.1.222"
)

echo "======================================"
echo "Homelab Migration Pre-Backup Script"
echo "======================================"
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

for container in "${CONTAINERS[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r name id ip <<< "$container"

    echo "----------------------------------------"
    echo "Backing up: $name (ID: $id, IP: $ip)"
    echo "----------------------------------------"

    backup_path="$BACKUP_DIR/$name"

# Authelia - Centralized Authentication
# https://www.authelia.com/

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key
      # OIDC env vars - uncomment when enabling OIDC clients
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_HMAC_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/oidc_hmac_secret
      # AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_OIDC_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE: /secrets/oidc_private_key
    ports:
      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer_agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# Create the base LXC container with nesting enabled for Docker
module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name           = var.name
  container_id   = var.container_id
  proxmox_node   = var.proxmox_node
  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  # Compute
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  # Storage
  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  mount_points   = var.mount_points

  # Network (DHCP only)
  network_bridge = var.network_bridge

  # Template
  template = var.template

  # Features - enable nesting for Docker/Podman
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Device passthrough
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu
  devices    = var.devices

  # Metadata
  description = var.description
  tags        = var.tags

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container configuration (apparmor)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path != "" ? var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path : var.ssh_private_key_path
}

# Wait for container to be accessible via SSH (with actual connectivity check)
resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH to become available on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "SSH is ready after $i attempts"
          exit 0
        fi
        echo "Attempt $i/30: SSH not ready, waiting 5s..."
        sleep 5
      done
      echo "ERROR: SSH never became available after 30 attempts (150s)"
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# Install Docker or Podman
resource "null_resource" "install_container_runtime" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
    runtime      = var.container_runtime
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      # Install Docker and rsync
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg", # Remove existing key to avoid interactive prompt
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config"
      ] : [
      # Install Podman and rsync
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y podman podman-compose rsync",
      "systemctl enable podman",
      "mkdir -p /config"
    ]
  }
}

# Deploy compose file if provided (single file mode)
resource "null_resource" "deploy_compose" {
  count      = var.compose_file != "" ? 1 : 0
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_container_runtime]

  triggers = {
    compose_hash = fileexists(var.compose_file) ? filemd5(var.compose_file) : "no-file"
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    source      = var.compose_file
    destination = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      "cd /config && docker compose pull",
      "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
      ] : [
      "cd /config && podman-compose pull",
      "cd /config && podman-compose up -d"
    ]
  }
}

# Sync compose directory using file-sync module
module "sync_compose_dir" {
  source = "../file-sync"
  count  = var.compose_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  source_dir           = var.compose_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = "/config"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Optional ownership settings
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # Optional file permissions
  file_permissions = var.config_file_permissions

  # Don't start services here - wait for env file to be created
  post_sync_commands = []

  depends_on = [null_resource.install_container_runtime]
}

# Create .env file from env_vars map
resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  count = length(var.env_vars) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_container_runtime,
    module.sync_compose_dir
  ]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256(jsonencode(var.env_vars))
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = concat(
      ["cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'"],
      [for k, v in var.env_vars : "${k}=${v}"],
      ["ENVEOF"],
      ["chmod 600 /config/.env"]
    )
  }
}

# Start services after env file is created (or immediately if no env vars)
resource "null_resource" "start_services" {
  count = var.compose_dir != "" || var.compose_file != "" ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_container_runtime,
    module.sync_compose_dir,
    null_resource.create_env_file,
    null_resource.deploy_compose
  ]

  triggers = {
    compose_hash = var.compose_dir != "" ? module.sync_compose_dir[0].content_hash : (
      var.compose_file != "" ? filemd5(var.compose_file) : "none"
    )
    env_hash = length(var.env_vars) > 0 ? sha256(jsonencode(var.env_vars)) : "none"
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      # Pull with retry
      <<-EOT
        cd /config
        for i in 1 2 3; do
          echo "docker compose pull attempt $i/3..."
          if docker compose pull; then
            echo "Pull successful"
            break
          fi
          if [ "$i" -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose pull failed after 3 attempts"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Pull failed, retrying in 10s..."
          sleep 10
        done
      EOT
      ,
      # Up with retry and health check
      <<-EOT
        cd /config
        for i in 1 2 3; do
          echo "docker compose up attempt $i/3..."
          if docker compose up -d; then
            echo "Containers started, waiting 5s for health check..."
            sleep 5
            # Check if any containers exited unexpectedly
            EXITED=$(docker compose ps --status exited -q 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
            if [ "$EXITED" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "All containers running"
              docker compose ps
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "WARNING: $EXITED container(s) exited, checking logs..."
            docker compose logs --tail=20
          fi
          if [ "$i" -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose up failed after 3 attempts"
            docker compose ps
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Retrying in 10s..."
          sleep 10
        done
      EOT
      ] : [
      "cd /config && podman-compose pull",
      "cd /config && podman-compose up -d"
    ]
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Authelia LXC - Centralized Authentication
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 202
# IP: 192.168.1.225
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authelia LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 202
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authelia Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authelia"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.authelia}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authelia"
  service_description = "Centralized authentication with TOTP 2FA and OIDC"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authelia", port = 9091, info = "Authentication portal" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Session storage" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Config:** `/config/authelia/configuration.yml`
**Users:** `/config/authelia/users_database.yml`
**Secrets:** `/config/secrets/` (synced from deploy/secrets)

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f authelia
```

**Check auth status:**
```
curl -I http://localhost:9091/api/health
```

**Restart Authelia:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart authelia
```

## ForwardAuth Middleware

Add `"authelia"` to any service's middleware list to protect it:
```hcl
middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authelia` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authelia", "auth", "security"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authelia"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.ip_registry.core.traefik
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authelia.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authelia.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authelia.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.authelia_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authelia_route.remote_config_path
}

# Authelia LXC - Centralized Authentication
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 202
# IP: 192.168.1.225
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authelia LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 202
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authelia Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authelia"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.authelia}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authelia"
  service_description = "Centralized authentication with TOTP 2FA and OIDC"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authelia", port = 9091, info = "Authentication portal" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Session storage" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Config:** `/config/authelia/configuration.yml`
**Users:** `/config/authelia/users_database.yml`
**Secrets:** `/config/secrets/` (synced from deploy/secrets)

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f authelia
```

**Check auth status:**
```
curl -I http://localhost:9091/api/health
```

**Restart Authelia:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart authelia
```

## ForwardAuth Middleware

Add `"authelia"` to any service's middleware list to protect it:
```hcl
middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authelia` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authelia", "auth", "security"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authelia_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authelia"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.ip_registry.core.traefik
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.authelia]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.authelia.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.authelia.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.authelia.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.authelia_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.authelia.ip_address}:9091"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.authelia_route.remote_config_path
}

#!/bin/bash
# Pre-migration backup script for docker-lxc module migration
# Backs up all container data and configurations before migration

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/homelab-migration-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
SSH_KEY="$HOME/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"

# Container mapping: name:id:ip
declare -a CONTAINERS=(
    "authelia:202:192.168.1.225"
    "immich-importer:203:192.168.1.223"
    "dashboards:201:192.168.1.234"
    "monitoring:500:192.168.1.229"
    "portainer:100:192.168.1.157"
    "openwebui:501:192.168.1.221"
    "jellyfin:401:192.168.1.226"
    "media-management:402:192.168.1.227"
    "immich:304:192.168.1.222"
)

echo "======================================"
echo "Homelab Migration Pre-Backup Script"
echo "======================================"
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

for container in "${CONTAINERS[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r name id ip <<< "$container"

    echo "----------------------------------------"
    echo "Backing up: $name (ID: $id, IP: $ip)"
    echo "----------------------------------------"

    backup_path="$BACKUP_DIR/$name"
    mkdir -p "$backup_path"

    # 1. Backup Proxmox LXC configuration
    echo "  [1/5] Backing up Proxmox LXC config..."
    ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" root@homelab "pct config $id" > "$backup_path/pct-config.txt" 2>&1 || {
        echo "    WARNING: Failed to backup LXC config for $name"
    }

    # 2. Backup /config directory (Docker compose and app configs)
    echo "  [2/5] Backing up /config directory..."
    rsync -avz -e "ssh -i $SSH_KEY" "root@$ip:/config/" "$backup_path/config/" 2>&1 || {
        echo "    WARNING: Failed to backup /config for $name"
    }

    # 3. List Docker volumes
    echo "  [3/5] Listing Docker volumes..."
    ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip" "docker volume ls" > "$backup_path/docker-volumes.txt" 2>&1 || {
        echo "    WARNING: Failed to list Docker volumes for $name"
    }

    # 4. Backup Docker volumes
    echo "  [4/5] Backing up Docker volumes..."
    volumes=$(ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip" "docker volume ls -q" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

    if [ -n "$volumes" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$backup_path/volumes"
        while IFS= read -r volume; do
            if [ -n "$volume" ]; then
                echo "    Backing up volume: $volume"
                ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip" "docker run --rm -v $volume:/volume -v /tmp:/backup alpine tar czf /backup/${volume}.tar.gz -C /volume ." 2>&1 || {
                    echo "      WARNING: Failed to backup volume $volume"
                    continue
                }
                scp -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip:/tmp/${volume}.tar.gz" "$backup_path/volumes/" 2>&1 || {
                    echo "      WARNING: Failed to download volume backup $volume"
                }
                ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip" "rm -f /tmp/${volume}.tar.gz" 2>&1 || true
            fi
        done <<< "$volumes"
    else
        echo "    No Docker volumes found"
    fi

    # 5. Export Docker images list
    echo "  [5/5] Listing Docker images..."
    ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$ip" "docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}'" > "$backup_path/docker-images.txt" 2>&1 || {
        echo "    WARNING: Failed to list Docker images for $name"
    }

    echo "  ✓ Backup completed for $name"
    echo ""
done

echo "======================================"
echo "Backup Summary"
echo "======================================"
echo "Backup location: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""
echo "Backed up containers:"
for container in "${CONTAINERS[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r name id ip <<< "$container"
    echo "  - $name (ID: $id)"
done
echo ""
echo "To restore a volume if needed:"
echo "  docker run --rm -v VOLUME_NAME:/volume -v /path/to/backup:/backup alpine tar xzf /backup/VOLUME.tar.gz -C /volume"
echo ""
echo "======================================"
echo "✓ Pre-migration backup complete!"
echo "======================================"
