# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only created if deploy_dir is provided

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running
  post_sync_commands = concat([
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ], var.post_sync_commands)

  # Set ownership if specified
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions

  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  provider = remotedockercompose

  # depends_on must be static, so we always include both
  depends_on = [
    module.lxc,
    module.file_sync
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file into one module.
#
# This is the gold standard pattern for all Docker app deployments.
#
# Usage:
#   module "my_app" {
#     source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
#
#     # Identity
#     name         = "my-app"
#     container_id = 100
#
#     # Network
#     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
#     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
#
#     # Resources
#     cores  = 2
#     memory = 2048
#
#     # Deployment
#     deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
#
#     # SSH
#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source = "bpg/proxmox"
    }
    null = {
      source = "hashicorp/null"
    }
    remotedockercompose = {
      source = "darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build Description for Proxmox UI
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  # Service name defaults to container name
  service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name

  # Build container description (supports markdown)
  # Note: We can't use the IP from module.lxc.ip_address here because of circular dependency
  # So we extract it from the input var.ip_address instead
  #
  # Timestamp is omitted because both timestamp() and plantimestamp() create drift:
  # - timestamp() changes on every plan/apply
  # - plantimestamp() changes on every plan (even if not applied)
  # To track last update time, Proxmox automatically tracks modification time
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = local.service_name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = var.ip_address != "" ? split("/", var.ip_address)[0] : ""
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Network
  ip_address = var.ip_address
  gateway    = var.gateway

  # Docker-ready template
  template = var.template

  # Container security
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Storage
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Description for Proxmox UI
  description = local.description

  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only created if deploy_dir is provided

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running
  post_sync_commands = concat([
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ], var.post_sync_commands)

  # Set ownership if specified
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions

  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  provider = remotedockercompose

  # depends_on must be static, so we always include both
  depends_on = [
    module.lxc,
    module.file_sync
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build Description for Proxmox UI

locals {
  # Service name defaults to container name
  service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name

  # Build container description (supports markdown)
  # Note: We can't use the IP from module.lxc.ip_address here because of circular dependency
  # So we extract it from the input var.ip_address instead

  # - timestamp() changes on every plan/apply
  # - plantimestamp() changes on every plan (even if not applied)
  # To track last update time, Proxmox automatically tracks modification time
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = local.service_name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = var.ip_address != "" ? split("/", var.ip_address)[0] : ""
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Network
  ip_address = var.ip_address
  gateway    = var.gateway

  # Docker-ready template
  template = var.template

  # Container security
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Storage
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Description for Proxmox UI
  description = local.description

  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Uses filesync provider to sync deployment files to the container

locals {
  # Get all files from deploy_dir if provided
  deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**/*") : []

  # Build map of files with their target paths
  files_map = var.deploy_dir != "" ? {
    for file in local.deploy_files :
    file => {
      source = "${var.deploy_dir}/${file}"
      target = "${var.target_path}/${file}"
    }
  } : {}
}

# Sync all files using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = local.files_map

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  source_file = each.value.source
  dest_file   = each.value.target

  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Ensure Docker is running and apply post-sync commands
resource "null_resource" "post_sync" {
  count = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  triggers = {
    files_hash = sha256(join(",", [for f in local.deploy_files : filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/${f}")]))
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = concat([
      "systemctl start docker || true",
      "systemctl enable docker || true"
    ], var.post_sync_commands)
  }

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  provider = remotedockercompose

  depends_on = [
    module.lxc,
    filesync_file.config_files,
    null_resource.post_sync
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notes are now managed directly via the LXC description parameter above
# The proxmox-notes module is deprecated and no longer needed

1→# Docker LXC Module
     2→
     3→Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers on Proxmox.
     4→
     5→## Features
     6→
     7→- **All-in-one**: Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file
     8→- **Docker-ready**: Uses pre-built Docker template for instant deployment
     9→- **Declarative**: No manual provisioners or SSH connections
    10→- **Flexible**: Supports privileged/unprivileged, custom resources, file permissions
    11→- **Documented**: Automatic Proxmox notes generation
    12→
    13→## Usage
    14→
    15→```hcl
    16→module "my_app" {
    17→  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
    18→
    19→  # Identity
    20→  name         = "my-app"
    21→  container_id = 150
    22→
    23→  # Network
    24→  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
    25→
    26→  # Resources
    27→  cores  = 2
    28→  memory = 2048
    29→
    30→  # Deployment
    31→  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
    32→
    33→  # SSH
    34→  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
    35→  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
    36→
    37→  # Proxmox notes
    38→  service_description = "My application"
    39→  service_urls = {
    40→    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→```
    44→
    45→## Requirements
    46→
    47→- Deploy directory must contain `docker-compose.yml`
    48→- Docker-ready LXC template (default: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst)
    49→- SSH access to Proxmox host (for privileged container features)
    50→
    51→## Directory Structure
    52→
    53→```
    54→tofu/apps/my-app/
    55→├── main.tf              # Module usage
    56→├── deploy/
    57→│   ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
    58→│   ├── .env                # Optional
    59→│   └── config/             # Optional additional configs
    60→```
    61→
    62→## Outputs
    63→
    64→- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID
    65→- `ip_address` - Container IP address
    66→- `ssh_command` - SSH command string
    67→- `mac_address` - Container MAC address
    68→- `lxc_module` - The underlying lxc-base module
    69→
    70→## Secret Management Pattern
    71→
    72→For applications that need secrets in environment files:
    73→
    74→```hcl
    75→# 1. Create template file
    76→# deploy/.env.tpl
    77→DB_PASSWORD=${db_password}
    78→API_KEY=${api_key}
    79→
    80→# 2. Generate local file with secrets
    81→resource "local_sensitive_file" "app_env" {
    82→  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    83→    db_password = local.op.postgres_password
    84→    api_key     = local.op.api_key
    85→  })
    86→  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/app.env"
    87→  file_permission = "0600"
    88→}
    89→
    90→# 3. Sync to container
    91→resource "filesync_file" "app_env" {
    92→  source      = local_sensitive_file.app_env.filename
    93→  destination = "/config/.env"
    94→  host        = "192.168.1.150"
    95→  mode        = "0600"
    96→  depends_on  = [module.my_app]
    97→}
    98→```

# Docker LXC Module

Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers on Proxmox.

## Features

- **All-in-one**: Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file
- **Docker-ready**: Uses pre-built Docker template for instant deployment
- **Declarative**: No manual provisioners or SSH connections
- **Flexible**: Supports privileged/unprivileged, custom resources, file permissions
- **Documented**: Automatic Proxmox notes generation

## Usage

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "my-app"
  container_id = 150

  # Network
  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"

  # Resources
  cores  = 2
  memory = 2048

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "My application"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
  }
}
```

## Requirements

- Deploy directory must contain `docker-compose.yml`
- Docker-ready LXC template (default: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst)
- SSH access to Proxmox host (for privileged container features)

## Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/my-app/
├── main.tf              # Module usage
├── deploy/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
│   ├── .env                # Optional
│   └── config/             # Optional additional configs
```

## Outputs

- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID
- `ip_address` - Container IP address
- `ssh_command` - SSH command string
- `mac_address` - Container MAC address
- `lxc_module` - The underlying lxc-base module

## Secret Management Pattern

For applications that need secrets in environment files:

```hcl
# 1. Create template file
# deploy/.env.tpl
DB_PASSWORD=${db_password}
API_KEY=${api_key}

# 2. Generate local file with secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "app_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    db_password = local.op.postgres_password
    api_key     = local.op.api_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/app.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

# 3. Sync to container
resource "filesync_file" "app_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.app_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = "192.168.1.150"
  mode        = "0600"
  depends_on  = [module.my_app]
}
```

**Benefits:**

- Fully declarative (no null_resource)
- Proper state tracking
- Secrets never in git
- Template-based configuration

## Common Patterns

### Privileged Containers

For applications binding to privileged ports (80, 443):

```hcl
module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  unprivileged = false  # Required for ports < 1024
}
```

### File Permissions

For specific file permission requirements:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  file_permissions = {
    "/config/scripts/backup.sh" = "0755"
    "/config/certs/cert.pem"    = "0400"
  }
}
```

### Custom Post-Sync Commands

Run additional commands after file sync:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  post_sync_commands = [
    "chown -R 1000:1000 /config/data",
    "chmod +x /config/scripts/*.sh"
  ]
}
```

### Custom Notes

Add operational documentation to Proxmox UI:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.150:8080"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main application interface" },
    { name = "API", port = 3000, info = "REST API endpoint" }
  ]
}
```

│           docker-lxc Module                 │

# =============================================================================
# File Sync Module
# =============================================================================
# Reusable module for syncing files/directories to remote hosts via SSH.
# Handles ownership issues properly by using rsync with --no-owner --no-group
# and optionally setting ownership after sync.
#
# Usage:
#   module "sync_config" {
#     source = "../modules/file-sync"
#
#     source_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
#     target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
#     target_path          = "/config"
#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
#
#     # Optional: set ownership after sync
#     owner = "traefik"
#     group = "traefik"
#
#     # Optional: set permissions on specific files
#     file_permissions = {
#       "/config/certs/acme.json" = "600"
#       "/config/.env"            = "600"
#     }
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# Calculate hash of all files in source directory for change detection
locals {
  # Get all files in source directory
  source_files = var.source_dir != "" ? fileset(var.source_dir, "**") : []

  # Calculate combined hash of all files
  content_hash = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.source_files) > 0 ? sha256(join("", [
    for f in local.source_files : filemd5("${var.source_dir}/${f}")
  ])) : "empty"

  # Build chown command if owner/group specified
  chown_command = var.owner != "" ? (
    var.group != "" ? "chown -R ${var.owner}:${var.group} ${var.target_path}" : "chown -R ${var.owner} ${var.target_path}"
  ) : ""

  # Build chmod commands for specific file permissions
  chmod_commands = [
    for path, mode in var.file_permissions : "chmod ${mode} ${path} 2>/dev/null || true"
  ]

  # Combine post-sync commands
  post_sync_commands = compact(concat(
    [local.chown_command],
    local.chmod_commands,
    var.post_sync_commands
  ))
}

# Sync files to target with retry logic and verification
resource "null_resource" "sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  triggers = {
    content_hash     = local.content_hash
    target_host      = var.target_host
    target_path      = var.target_path
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
  }

  # Use rsync with retry logic, checksum verification, and proper error handling
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      set -e

      SSH_OPTS="-i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10"
      MAX_RETRIES=3
      RETRY_DELAY=5

      # Retry loop for rsync
      for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
        echo "rsync attempt $attempt/$MAX_RETRIES..."

        if rsync -avz --checksum ${var.delete_extra ? "--delete" : ""} --no-owner --no-group \
          -e "ssh $SSH_OPTS" \
          ${var.source_dir}/ \
          root@${var.target_host}:${var.target_path}/; then
          echo "rsync completed successfully"
          break
        fi

        if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: rsync failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "rsync failed, retrying in $RETRY_DELAY seconds..."
        sleep $RETRY_DELAY
      done

      # Verify sync by checking file count matches
      LOCAL_COUNT=$(find ${var.source_dir} -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      REMOTE_COUNT=$(ssh $SSH_OPTS root@${var.target_host} "find ${var.target_path} -type f | wc -l" | tr -d ' ')

      echo "Verification: Local files=$LOCAL_COUNT, Remote files=$REMOTE_COUNT"

      if [ "$LOCAL_COUNT" != "$REMOTE_COUNT" ]; then
        echo "WARNING: File count mismatch (local=$LOCAL_COUNT, remote=$REMOTE_COUNT)"
        echo "This may be expected if delete_extra=false and remote has additional files"
      fi

      echo "File sync completed and verified"
    EOF
  }
}

# Separate resource for post-sync commands to ensure proper execution
resource "null_resource" "post_sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.post_sync_commands) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [null_resource.sync]

  triggers = {
    sync_id          = null_resource.sync[0].id
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
    post_commands    = jsonencode(var.post_sync_commands)
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = var.target_host
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = local.post_sync_commands
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Combines lxc-base + file-sync + remote-docker-compose-file for a complete
# declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    remotedockercompose = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address     = var.ip_address
  gateway        = var.gateway
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

input.content:
# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
    remotedockercompose = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/remotedockercompose"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address     = var.ip_address
  gateway        = var.gateway
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name        = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    service_description = var.service_description
    container_id        = var.container_id
    ip_address          = split("/", var.ip_address)[0]
    service_urls        = var.service_urls
    services            = var.services
    custom_notes        = var.custom_notes
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory
locals {
  deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Combines lxc-base + file-sync + remote-docker-compose-file for a complete
# declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address     = var.ip_address
  gateway        = var.gateway
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key              = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host            = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name        = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    service_description = var.service_description
    container_id        = var.container_id
    ip_address          = split("/", var.ip_address)[0]
    service_urls        = var.service_urls
    services            = var.services
    custom_notes        = var.custom_notes
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ownership
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions
  delete_extra     = var.delete_extra_files

  # Post-sync commands
  post_sync_commands = var.post_sync_commands

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Start Docker Compose stack after file sync completes

resource "null_resource" "docker_compose" {
  count = var.deploy_dir != "" && var.docker_compose_up ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [module.file_sync]

  triggers = {
    # Re-run when file sync changes
    file_sync_id = var.deploy_dir != "" ? module.file_sync[0].sync_id : ""
    compose_validate = var.docker_compose_validate
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = concat(
      var.docker_compose_validate ? [
        "cd ${var.target_path}",
        "docker compose config > /dev/null || (echo 'ERROR: Invalid docker-compose.yml' && exit 1)",
        "echo 'Docker compose file validated successfully'"
      ] : [],
      [
        "cd ${var.target_path}",
        "docker compose up -d",
        "echo 'Docker compose stack started successfully'"
      ]
    )
  }
}

  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features

  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

    container_id        = var.container_id

    service_urls        = var.service_urls
    services            = var.services
    custom_notes        = var.custom_notes
  }) : ""

  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)

# File Sync
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions
  delete_extra     = var.delete_extra_files

  # Post-sync commands
  post_sync_commands = var.post_sync_commands

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Start Docker Compose stack after file sync completes

resource "null_resource" "docker_compose" {
  count = var.deploy_dir != "" && var.docker_compose_up ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [module.file_sync]

  triggers = {
    # Re-run when file sync changes
    file_sync_id = var.deploy_dir != "" ? module.file_sync[0].sync_id : ""
    compose_validate = var.docker_compose_validate
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = concat(
      var.docker_compose_validate ? [
        "cd ${var.target_path}",
        "docker compose config > /dev/null || (echo 'ERROR: Invalid docker-compose.yml' && exit 1)",
        "echo 'Docker compose file validated successfully'"
      ] : [],
      [
        "cd ${var.target_path}",
        "docker compose up -d",
        "echo 'Docker compose stack started successfully'"
      ]
    )
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Immich LXC - Photo & Video Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 304 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Note: This app imports an existing LXC container rather than creating new.
# Immich runs as Docker containers with GPU acceleration for ML features.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Immich LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 6
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 6144
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 24
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # Existing container is privileged for GPU access
}

variable "enable_gpu" {
  description = "Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # GPU added manually via SSH (API token can't manage device passthrough)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # GPU passthrough - managed outside of Terraform due to API limitations
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  tags = ["opentofu", "photos", "immich", "media"]

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container apparmor configuration
  proxmox_ssh_host = var.proxmox_ssh_host
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Immich"
  description  = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.docker_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** `/var/lib/docker/volumes/immich_pgdata`

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M is passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f
```

**Restart all services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Backup

Database backups should be configured via Immich admin panel.
Photos are stored on ZFS pool with automatic snapshots.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.docker_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:2283"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
    remotedockercompose = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/remotedockercompose"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address     = var.ip_address
  gateway        = var.gateway
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name        = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    service_description = var.service_description
    container_id        = var.container_id
    ip_address          = split("/", var.ip_address)[0]
    service_urls        = var.service_urls
    services            = var.services
    custom_notes        = var.custom_notes
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory
locals {
  deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = var.deploy_dir != "" ? toset(local.deploy_files) : toset([])

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  mode        = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  mode        = each.value

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose - Using remotedockercompose provider
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remotedockercompose_compose" "stack" {
  count = var.deploy_dir != "" && var.docker_compose_up ? 1 : 0

  name       = var.name
  host       = module.lxc.ip_address
  workingdir = var.target_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address     = var.ip_address
  gateway        = var.gateway
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/../proxmox-notes/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name        = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    service_description = var.service_description
    container_id        = var.container_id
    ip_address          = split("/", var.ip_address)[0]
    service_urls        = var.service_urls
    services            = var.services
    custom_notes        = var.custom_notes
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory
locals {
  deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = var.deploy_dir != "" ? toset(local.deploy_files) : toset([])

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  mode        = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  mode        = each.value

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

I see the problem! Traefik is configured to redirect HTTP to HTTPS on the `web` entrypoint, but the public routes are using the `web` entrypoint (HTTP) expecting Cloudflare to handle TLS. This creates a redirect loop:

1. Cloudflare receives HTTPS request
2. Cloudflare forwards HTTP to Traefik's web entrypoint
3. Traefik redirects HTTP → HTTPS
4. Loop

The issue is in the traefik-route module - public routes should NOT use the `web` entrypoint when there's an HTTP→HTTPS redirect configured. They should either:

**Option 1:** Use `websecure` entrypoint and Cloudflare Flexible SSL mode
**Option 2:** Create a separate entrypoint without redirect for public routes

Still getting a 308 redirect from Cloudflare. The issue is that Cloudflare's SSL/TLS mode is likely set to "Flexible" (Cloudflare→HTTP→Origin), but now Traefik only accepts HTTPS on the websecure entrypoint.

The redirect loop happens because:

2. Traefik has no listener on HTTP for photos.rambtech.dev (only websecure/443)

# Traefik v3 static configuration for homelab
global:
  checkNewVersion: false
  sendAnonymousUsage: false

api:
  dashboard: true
  debug: false
  insecure: false

# Health check endpoint for Docker healthcheck
ping:
  entryPoint: ping

# Prometheus metrics endpoint
metrics:
  prometheus:
    entryPoint: metrics
    addEntryPointsLabels: true
    addRoutersLabels: true
    addServicesLabels: true

entryPoints:
  web:
    address: ":80"
    http:
      redirections:
        entryPoint:
          to: websecure
          scheme: https
  websecure:
    address: ":443"
    http:
      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
  metrics:
    address: ":8082"
  ping:
    address: ":8081"

providers:
  file:
    directory: "/config/dynamic"
    watch: true

# Traefik v3 syntax for certificate resolvers
certificatesResolvers:
  letsencrypt:
    acme:
      email: darshanrambhia@live.com
      storage: /config/certs/acme.json
      dnsChallenge:
        provider: cloudflare
        resolvers:
          - "1.1.1.1:53"
          - "1.0.0.1:53"
        delayBeforeCheck: 60s

log:
  level: INFO
  filePath: "/config/logs/traefik.log"

accessLog:
  filePath: "/config/logs/access.log"

serversTransport:
  insecureSkipVerify: true

# =============================================================================
# Network Services LXC - AdGuard + Cloudflared + DDNS
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 101 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Note: This app imports an existing LXC container rather than creating new.
# Tailscale remains as a systemd service (requires kernel access).

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for network-services LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 101
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4  # Match existing container
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024  # Match existing container
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false # Existing container is privileged for Tailscale
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tokens are now fetched from 1Password via local.op.*

variable "cloudflare_ddns_domains" {
  description = "Domains to update with DDNS"
  type        = string
  default     = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  tags = ["opentofu", "network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container apparmor configuration
  proxmox_ssh_host = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Environment variables for Docker Compose (.env file)
  # Cloudflare tokens fetched from 1Password
  env_vars = {
    CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN = local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token
    CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN    = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS = var.cloudflare_ddns_domains
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Network Services"
  description  = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking (upstream: Cloudflare)" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface (via Traefik)" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.docker_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

**Re-authenticate (if expired):**
```
tailscale up --auth-key=<key>
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```
dig @${module.docker_host.ip_address} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```
dig @${module.docker_host.ip_address} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.docker_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
  }
}

# =============================================================================

terraform {

# ⚠️ DEPRECATED MODULE

This module is **deprecated** and should not be used for new deployments.

## Use Instead

The **docker-lxc** module now handles Proxmox notes automatically via the `description` parameter on the LXC resource. No separate module needed.

## Why Deprecated

- Proxmox notes are now managed directly in the LXC description field
- Eliminates circular dependency issues
- No null_resource provisioners needed
- Better declarative resource management

## Current Usage

This module is still used by:
- `network-services` - Needs migration to docker-lxc
- `immich` - Needs migration to docker-lxc
- `immich-importer` - Needs migration to docker-lxc

Once these apps are migrated, this module will be deleted.

## Date Deprecated

December 10, 2025

#!/bin/bash
# Cloud backup sync to Backblaze B2 (encrypted)
# Runs on LXC 303 (immich-importer)

set -eu

ACTION="${1:-photos}"
DRY_RUN=""
if [ "${2:-}" = "--dry-run" ]; then
    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
fi

# Use encrypted remote for photos
B2_CRYPT="b2-crypt:"
PHOTOS_LOCAL="/photos"

RCLONE_FLAGS="--progress --transfers 4 --checkers 8 --fast-list"

sync_photos() {
    echo "=== Syncing photos to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $PHOTOS_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   $B2_CRYPT"
    echo ""

    rclone sync $PHOTOS_LOCAL $B2_CRYPT \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        --exclude "*.tmp" \
        --exclude "thumbs/**" \
        --exclude "cache/**" \
        --exclude "encoded-video/**" \
        $DRY_RUN
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== B2 Photos Backup Status - Encrypted ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Remote contents:"
    rclone lsd $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "empty or not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Remote size:"
    rclone size $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local size:"
    du -sh $PHOTOS_LOCAL 2>/dev/null || echo "calculating..."
}

case "$ACTION" in
    photos)
        sync_photos
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [photos|status] [--dry-run]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "Done"

# =============================================================================
# Immich Importer LXC - Photo Import & Cloud Backup
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 303 (existing)
# IP: 192.168.1.159
#
# Run immich-go for Google Photos import, rclone for B2 cloud backup.
# Non-Docker LXC with direct tool installation.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 303
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

# Backblaze B2 credentials (from 1Password)
variable "b2_account_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "b2_application_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password2" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Immich configuration
variable "immich_server" {
  type    = string
  default = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
}

variable "immich_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Cloud backup schedule
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "0 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Importer Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "immich-importer"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Ubuntu template (matches existing container)
  template = "local:vztmpl/ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst"
  os_type  = "ubuntu"

  # Container features
  unprivileged   = true
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  # Mount points for photos and imports
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      volume = "/tank/photos"
      path   = "/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
      path   = "/cache"
    },
    {
      slot   = 2
      volume = "/tank/importer"
      path   = "/importer"
    },
    {
      slot   = 3
      volume = "/tank/photo-import"
      path   = "/downloads"
    }
  ]

  # Proxmox Notes
  description = <<-EOT
# Immich Importer

Photo import (immich-go) and cloud backup (rclone to B2)

## Services

- **immich-go**: Google Photos importer
- **rclone**: Cloud backup to B2 (encrypted)

## Management

- SSH: `ssh root@${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}`

## Cloud Backup

**Schedule:** ${var.cloud_backup_schedule} (Wed and Sun 3 AM EST)

**Commands:**
```bash
task cloud:sync:photos
task cloud:status:photos
task cloud:logs:photos
```

## Manual Import

**Run immich-go:**
```bash
immich-go -server ${var.immich_server} upload /downloads
```

## Rclone Status

**Check B2 sync status:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status
```

**Manual sync:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich-importer` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["immich-importer", "backup", "rclone", "opentofu"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for container to be ready
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_container" {
  depends_on      = [module.lxc]
  create_duration = "10s"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Dependencies (rclone, immich-go)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_dependencies" {
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_container]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive",
      "apt-get update -qq",
      "apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip cron",

      # Install rclone
      "if ! command -v rclone &>/dev/null; then curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash; fi",

      # Install immich-go (latest release)
      "if ! command -v immich-go &>/dev/null; then",
      "  IMMICH_GO_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'\"' -f4)",
      "  curl -fsSL https://github.com/simulot/immich-go/releases/download/$${IMMICH_GO_VERSION}/immich-go_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C /usr/local/bin immich-go",
      "  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/immich-go",
      "fi",

      # Create directories
      "mkdir -p /root/.config/rclone",
      "mkdir -p /var/log",
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure rclone
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_rclone" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_dependencies]

  triggers = {
    container_id    = var.container_id
    b2_account_id   = var.b2_account_id
    crypt_password  = var.rclone_crypt_password
    crypt_password2 = var.rclone_crypt_password2
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      <<-RCLONE
      cat > /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf << 'CONF'
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${var.b2_account_id}
key = ${var.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/photos-encrypted
password = ${var.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${var.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
      chmod 600 /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
      RCLONE
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Cloud Sync Script
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "deploy_cloud_sync" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.configure_rclone]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    script_hash  = filesha256("${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
    destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure Cron Job for Cloud Backup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.deploy_cloud_sync]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    schedule     = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      # Remove existing cloud-sync cron entries
      "crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'cloud-sync.sh' | crontab - || true",

      # Add new cron entry
      "(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '${var.cloud_backup_schedule} /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1') | crontab -",

      # Ensure cron service is running
      "systemctl enable cron",
      "systemctl start cron",

      "echo 'Cron configured: ${var.cloud_backup_schedule}'"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.lxc.ssh_command
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

task cloud:sync:photos
task cloud:status:photos
task cloud:logs:photos
```

## Manual Import

**Run immich-go:**
```bash
immich-go -server ${var.immich_server} upload /downloads
```

## Rclone Status

**Check B2 sync status:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status
```

**Manual sync:**
```bash
/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich-importer` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["immich-importer", "backup", "rclone", "opentofu"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for container to be ready
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_container" {
  depends_on      = [module.lxc]
  create_duration = "10s"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Dependencies (rclone, immich-go)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_dependencies" {
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_container]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive",
      "apt-get update -qq",
      "apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip cron",

      # Install rclone
      "if ! command -v rclone &>/dev/null; then curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash; fi",

      # Install immich-go (latest release)
      "if ! command -v immich-go &>/dev/null; then",
      "  IMMICH_GO_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'\"' -f4)",
      "  curl -fsSL https://github.com/simulot/immich-go/releases/download/$${IMMICH_GO_VERSION}/immich-go_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C /usr/local/bin immich-go",
      "  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/immich-go",
      "fi",

      # Create directories
      "mkdir -p /root/.config/rclone",
      "mkdir -p /var/log",
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure rclone
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_rclone" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_dependencies]

  triggers = {
    container_id    = var.container_id
    b2_account_id   = var.b2_account_id
    crypt_password  = var.rclone_crypt_password
    crypt_password2 = var.rclone_crypt_password2
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      <<-RCLONE
      cat > /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf << 'CONF'
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${var.b2_account_id}
key = ${var.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/photos-encrypted
password = ${var.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${var.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
      chmod 600 /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
      RCLONE
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Cloud Sync Script
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "deploy_cloud_sync" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.configure_rclone]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    script_hash  = filesha256("${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
    destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure Cron Job for Cloud Backup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.deploy_cloud_sync]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    schedule     = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      # Remove existing cloud-sync cron entries
      "crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'cloud-sync.sh' | crontab - || true",

      # Add new cron entry
      "(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '${var.cloud_backup_schedule} /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1') | crontab -",

      # Ensure cron service is running
      "systemctl enable cron",
      "systemctl start cron",

      "echo 'Cron configured: ${var.cloud_backup_schedule}'"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.lxc.ssh_command
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

# =============================================================================
# Immich Importer LXC - Photo Import & Cloud Backup
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 303 (existing)
# IP: 192.168.1.159
#
# Run immich-go for Google Photos import, rclone for B2 cloud backup.
# Non-Docker LXC with direct tool installation.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 303
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 512
}

# Backblaze B2 credentials (from 1Password)
variable "b2_account_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "b2_application_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "rclone_crypt_password2" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Immich configuration
variable "immich_server" {
  type    = string
  default = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
}

variable "immich_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Cloud backup schedule
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "0 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Importer Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "immich-importer"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Ubuntu template (matches existing container)
  template = "local:vztmpl/ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst"
  os_type  = "ubuntu"

  # Container features
  unprivileged   = true
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  # Mount points for photos and imports
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      volume = "/tank/photos"
      path   = "/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
      path   = "/cache"
    },
    {
      slot   = 2
      volume = "/tank/importer"
      path   = "/importer"
    },
    {
      slot   = 3
      volume = "/tank/photo-import"
      path   = "/downloads"
    }
  ]

  # Proxmox Notes
  description = <<-EOT
# Immich Importer

Photo import (immich-go) and cloud backup (rclone to B2)

## Services

- **immich-go**: Google Photos importer
- **rclone**: Cloud backup to B2 (encrypted)

## Management

- SSH: `ssh root@${local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer}`

## Cloud Backup

**Schedule:** ${var.cloud_backup_schedule} (Wed and Sun 3 AM EST)

**Commands:**
```bash
task cloud:sync:photos
task cloud:status:photos
task cloud:logs:photos
```

## Manual Import

**Run immich-go:**
```bash
immich-go -server ${var.immich_server} upload /downloads

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Usage:
#   1. When deploying a new service, check `local.next_available_ip` for the
#      next free IP in the LXC range (192.168.1.150-199)
#   2. Add the new allocation to the appropriate category below
#   3. Use `local.ip_registry.<category>.<name>` in your module configs
#
# Ranges:
#   - 192.168.1.1-99:     Infrastructure (router, Proxmox, switches)
#   - 192.168.1.100-149:  Core services (Traefik, Portainer, DNS)
#   - 192.168.1.150-199:  LXC containers (apps)
#   - 192.168.1.200-224:  Reserved for manual/temporary use
#   - 192.168.1.225-254:  Special services & overflow
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    netmask = "/24"
    prefix  = "192.168.1"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - All Static Allocations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure devices (1-99)
    infrastructure = {
      router           = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox          = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host
    }

    # Core services (100-149)
    core = {
      portainer        = "192.168.1.157"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Unbound
      traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
    }

    # Application LXCs (150-199 preferred range for new deployments)
    apps = {
      dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
      immich_importer  = "192.168.1.159"  # LXC 303 - Photo import (estimated)
      immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
      jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "192.168.1.227"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack (Radarr, Sonarr, etc)
      monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
    }

    # Reserved IPs (for future use or manual assignment)
    reserved = {
      # 192.168.1.200-224 - Manual/temporary use
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for collision detection
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_allocated_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.infrastructure),
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.apps),
  )

  # Extract the last octet from each IP for range calculations
  _allocated_octets = [
    for ip in local._all_allocated_ips : tonumber(split(".", ip)[3])
  ]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Deploy Docker Template to Proxmox
# =============================================================================
# Copies the create-docker-template.sh script to Proxmox and executes it.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh                    # Debian 13 + Docker
#   ./deploy.sh ubuntu             # Ubuntu 24.04 + Docker
#   ./deploy.sh check              # Check if template exists
#   ./deploy.sh list               # List available templates
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SSH_KEY="${SSH_KEY:-~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519}"
PROXMOX_HOST="${PROXMOX_HOST:-192.168.1.215}"

case "${1:-debian}" in
    debian)
        echo "Creating Debian 13 + Docker template..."
        scp -i "$SSH_KEY" "$SCRIPT_DIR/create-docker-template.sh" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST:/tmp/"
        ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST" "chmod +x /tmp/create-docker-template.sh && /tmp/create-docker-template.sh && rm /tmp/create-docker-template.sh"
        ;;
    ubuntu)
        echo "Creating Ubuntu 24.04 + Docker template..."
        scp -i "$SSH_KEY" "$SCRIPT_DIR/create-docker-template.sh" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST:/tmp/"
        ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST" "chmod +x /tmp/create-docker-template.sh && \
            BASE_TEMPLATE='local:vztmpl/ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst' \
            OUTPUT_NAME='ubuntu-24.04-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst' \
            TEMPLATE_NAME='ubuntu-24.04-docker-template' \
            /tmp/create-docker-template.sh && rm /tmp/create-docker-template.sh"
        ;;
    check)
        if ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST" "ls /var/lib/vz/template/cache/debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ Docker template exists: local:vztmpl/debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst"
        else
            echo "❌ Docker template not found. Run: ./deploy.sh"
        fi
        ;;
    list)
        ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "root@$PROXMOX_HOST" "ls -lh /var/lib/vz/template/cache/"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [debian|ubuntu|check|list]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
