toolUseResult.originalFile:
# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # Import Existing Infrastructure
  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing LXC into an app's state (APP=dashboards|portainer|network-services)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    requires:
      vars: [APP, CONTAINER_ID]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing LXC (ID: {{.CONTAINER_ID}}) into {{.APP}} state..."
        tofu import 'module.docker_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/{{.CONTAINER_ID}}'

  tofu:import:traefik:
    desc: "Import existing Traefik LXC (ID 200) into state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik"
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP=traefik' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing Traefik LXC (ID: 200) into state..."
        tofu import 'module.traefik_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/200'

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Configuration
  tofu:config:create:
    desc: "Create terraform.tfvars from example"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -f terraform.tfvars ]; then
          echo "terraform.tfvars already exists. Remove it first to recreate."
          exit 1
        fi
        cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
        echo "Created terraform.tfvars - edit it with your values"

  tofu:config:edit:
    desc: "Edit terraform.tfvars"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - ${EDITOR:-vim} terraform.tfvars

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # LXC Template Management
  # ===========================================================================

  template:docker:create:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Debian LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh debian

  template:docker:create:ubuntu:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Ubuntu LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh ubuntu

  template:list:
    desc: "List available LXC templates on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh list

  template:docker:check:
    desc: "Check if Docker template exists"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh check

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

toolUseResult.originalFile:
# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Configuration
  tofu:config:create:
    desc: "Create terraform.tfvars from example"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -f terraform.tfvars ]; then
          echo "terraform.tfvars already exists. Remove it first to recreate."
          exit 1
        fi
        cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
        echo "Created terraform.tfvars - edit it with your values"

  tofu:config:edit:
    desc: "Edit terraform.tfvars"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - ${EDITOR:-vim} terraform.tfvars

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # LXC Template Management
  # ===========================================================================

  template:docker:create:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Debian LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh debian

  template:docker:create:ubuntu:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Ubuntu LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh ubuntu

  template:list:
    desc: "List available LXC templates on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh list

  template:docker:check:
    desc: "Check if Docker template exists"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh check

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

toolUseResult.originalFile:
# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
